compiler_spec.fixture_abi: x86_64 host C++11 synthetic control-flow objects; no source-language decompilation

analysis_options.debug_macros: BLOCKCONSISTENT_DEBUG is unset, matching the release oracle
analysis_options.initial_parent_policy: structured children and counter graph nodes are directly owned in order with parent=null on both sides

input_manifest.analysis_options: direct locked virtual calls plus two CollapseStructure::collapseAll counter paths
input_manifest.edge_labels: distinct raw oracle bits on both halves, including parallel and self edges
input_manifest.virtual_children: fixed-return probes record every toporbottom argument; true/false return combinations are explicit

normalization.pointer_identity: Only raw pointer/Arc addresses are replaced by fixed construction names (top, f, t, p, list, cond, c0, c1)
normalization.edge_order: none; every in/out slot is emitted in stored order
normalization.labels_reverse_indices_flags_opcode: none; emitted as exact raw values
normalization.counter_projection: none; count, final graph size, and child-call sequence are emitted directly

observation_schema.stdout: Fourteen fixed-order UTF-8 lines with final newline: envelope, eleven negate cases, two counter cases
observation_schema.negate_state: virtual return sequence, top identity, raw BOOL opcode, every named node raw flags/calls, complete ordered out and in halves with peer name/raw label/reverse_index
observation_schema.counter_state: CollapseStructure public dataflow change count, final BlockGraph size, and condition virtual-call sequence
observation_schema.stderr: Ghidra must be empty; Rugra's four current production diagnostics are pinned separately and retained as a full-process residual

overlay.policy: All 95 live src/**/*.rs regular files are length-prefixed and overlaid on the pinned base; this freezes the coherent uncommitted source state needed by the fixture
overlay.hash_scheme: sha256 of rugra-block-structured-negate-full-src-overlay-v1 NUL plus sorted length-prefixed relative path/content pairs

covered.flow_base_top_gate: MATCH: false performs no mutation; true swaps the two full out half-edges, repairs both reciprocal in-half reverse indices, toggles only f_flip_path, and returns false
covered.distinct_parallel_self_edges: MATCH: labels travel with the swapped out-half object and exact reciprocal slots are repaired for distinct targets, two parallel edges to one target, and two legal self edges
covered.double_negate: MATCH: distinct-edge FlowBlock, BlockList, and BlockCondition cases round-trip edge order, reverse indices, f_flip_path, and BOOL opcode
covered.blocklist_dispatch: MATCH: only the last child receives negateCondition(false); its exact virtual return is propagated; only toporbottom=true swaps the BlockList exits
covered.blockcondition_dispatch: MATCH: both children receive negateCondition(false) in first/second order without short-circuit, returns are OR-combined, BOOL_AND/BOOL_OR always toggle, and only toporbottom=true swaps exits
covered.dataflow_counter_split: MATCH: a three-node Cat structural collapse reaches graph_size=1 with count=0; a three-node ProperIf requiring one true virtual negate return reaches graph_size=1 with count=1

residual.rugra_diagnostic_stderr: MISMATCH: scoped method/state stdout is byte-identical, but Rugra currently emits four deterministic [COLLAPSE]/[BLOCKSTRUCT] stderr lines while Ghidra emits none; stderr is pinned, not normalized away
residual.blockbasic_blockcopy: UNTESTED: BlockBasic's PcodeOp flag mutation and BlockCopy's two-level delegation are outside this fixture
residual.nonbinary_error_path: UNTESTED: Ghidra's size assertion exists only under BLOCKCONSISTENT_DEBUG; release invalid-arity behavior is not invoked
residual.factory_opcode_seed: UNTESTED: BlockGraph::newBlockCondition's constructor-time opcode choice is outside the direct BOOL_AND/BOOL_OR virtual-method cases
residual.collapse_full_state: UNTESTED: the two counter cases intentionally project public count/final graph size/call order, not every post-collapse hierarchy field or every structuring rule
residual.production_parent_wiring: UNTESTED: the isolated structured children start parent=null on both sides; BlockGraph::addBlock/identifyInternal parent wiring is covered by separate fixtures
